0022600114.text: Orlando (0-2, 4th in the Southeast and 14th in the East) visits New York (0-2, 5th in the Atlantic and 12th in the East), with both teams still searching for their first win of the 2026-27 season. Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery) and Noah Penda (hamstring strain) are out for the Magic, while Anthony Black (ankle sprain), Jonathan Isaac (knee), and Paolo Banchero (ankle soreness) are day-to-day with game-time decisions, and Banchero is averaging 35.0 points and 41.2 minutes per game this season. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 2-2, with the most recent meeting on December 13, 2025 in Orlando, where the Magic lost 132-120.
